verses: Adam, Shet, Enosh,
Qenan, Mahalal᾽el, Yered,
Ḥanokh, Metushelaĥ, Lemekh,
Noaĥ, Shem, Ḥam, and Yefet.
The sons of Yefet; Gomer, and Magog, and Maday, and Yavan, and Tuval, and Meshekh, and Tiras.
And the sons of Gommer; Ashkenaz, and Difat, and Togarma.
And the sons of Yavan; Elisha, and Tarshisha, Kittim, and Rodanim.
The sons of Ḥam; Kush, and Miżrayim, Put, and Kena῾an.
And the sons of Kush; Seva, and Ḥavila, and Savta, and Ra῾ma, and Savtekha. And the sons of Ra῾ma; Sheva, and Dedan.
And Kush begot Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.
And Miżrayim begot Ludim, and ῾Anamim, and Lehavim, and Naftuĥim,
and Patrusim, and Kasluĥim, (of whom came to the Pelishtim,) and Kaftorim.
And Kena῾an begot Żidon his firstborn, and Ḥet,
and the Yevusi, and the Emori, and the Girgashi,
and the Ḥivvi and the Arqi, and the Sini,
and the Arvadi, and the Żemari, and the Ḥamati.
The sons of Shem; ῾Elam, and Ashshur, and Arpakhshad, and Lud, and Aram, and ῾Uż, and Ḥul, and Geter, and Meshekh.
And Arpakhshad begot Shelaĥ, and Shelaĥ begot ῾Ever.
And to ῾Ever were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother’s name was Yoqtan.
And Yoqtan begot Almodad, and Shelef, and Ḥażarmavet, and Yeraĥ,
and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diqla,
and ῾Eval, and Avima᾽el, and Sheva,
and Ofir, and Ḥavila, and Yovav. All these were the sons of Yoqtan.
Shem, Arpakhshad, Shelaĥ,
῾Ever, Peleg, Re῾u,
Serug, Naĥor, Teraĥ,
Avram; the same is Avraham.
The sons of Avraham; Yiżĥaq, and Yishma᾽el.
These are their generations: The firstborn of Yishma᾽el, Nevayot; then Qedar, and Adbe᾽el, and Mivsam,
Mishma, and Duma, Massa, Ḥadad, and Tema,
Yetur, Nafish, and Qedema. These are the sons of Yishma᾽el.
Now the sons of Qetura, Avraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, and Yoqshan, and Medan, and Midyan, and Yishbaq, and Shuaĥ. And the sons of Yoqshan; Sheva, and Dedan.
And the sons of Midyan; ῾Efa, and ῾Efer, and Ḥanokh, and Avida, and Elda῾a. All these are the sons of Qetura.
And Avraham begot Yiżĥaq. The sons of Yiżĥaq; ῾Esav and Yisra᾽el.
The sons of ῾Esav; Elifaz, Re῾u᾽el, and Ye῾ush, and Ya῾lam, and Qoraĥ.
The sons of Elifaz; Teman, and Omar, Żefi, and Ga῾tam, Qenaz, and Timna, and ῾Amaleq.
The sons of Re῾u᾽el; Naĥat, Zeraĥ, Shamma, and Mizza.
And the sons of Se῾ir; Lotan, and Shoval, and Żiv῾on, and ῾Ana, and Dishon, and Eżer, and Dishan.
And the sons of Lotan; Ḥori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan’s sister.
The sons of Shoval; ῾Alyan, and Manaĥat, and ῾Eval, Shefi, and Onam. And the sons of Żiv῾on; Ayya, and ῾Ana.
The sons of ῾Ana; Dishon.      And the sons of Dishon; Ḥamran, and Eshban, and Yitran, and Keran.
The sons of Eżer; Bilhan, and Za῾avan, and Ya῾aqan. The sons of Dishan; ῾Uż, and Aran.
Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Yisra᾽el; Bela the son of Be῾or: and the name of his city was Dinhava.
And when Bela was dead, Yovav the son of Zeraĥ of Bożra reigned in his place.
And when Yovav was dead, Ḥusham of the land of the Temani reigned in his place.
And when Ḥusham was dead, Ḥadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midyan in the field of Mo᾽av, reigned in his place: and the name of his city was ῾Avit.
And when Ḥadad was dead, Samla of Masreqa reigned in his place.
And when Samla was dead, Sha᾽ul of Reĥovot by the river reigned in his place.
And when Sha᾽ul was dead, Ba῾al-ĥanan the son of Akhbor reigned in his place.
And when Ba῾al-ĥanan was dead, Ḥadad reigned in his place: and the name of his city was Pa῾i; and his wife’s name was Mehetav᾽el, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahav.
Ḥadad died also. And the chiefs of Edom were; chief Timna, chief ῾Alva, chief Yetet,
chief Oholivama, chief Ela, chief Pinon,
chief Qenaz, chief Teman, chief Mivżar,
chief Magdi᾽el, chief ῾Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.
